steps.title: Configure System Permissions in Android Manifest
steps.description: Ensure Internet, Foreground Service, Media Playback, and Wake Lock permissions are configured in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Enhance Custom WebView Engine for Screen Off Playback
steps.description: Override WebView window visibility hooks so WebKit audio engine continuously renders when app is minimized or screen is locked.

steps.title: Implement Foreground Audio Service and Notification Controller
steps.description: Configure BackgroundAudioService with Android 14 MediaPlayback service type and system notification controls.

steps.title: Configure Partial Wake Lock and Wi-Fi Streaming Lock
steps.description: Acquire CPU Partial Wake Lock and High Performance Wi-Fi Lock to prevent network throttling and device sleep when screen turns off.

steps.title: Inject Web Visibility & Pause Anti-Throttling JavaScript
steps.description: Inject scripts to override document.hidden, intercept HTML5 video pause calls, and prevent audio suspension when changing apps.

steps.title: Register Screen Lock & Display Off Broadcast Receivers
steps.description: Listen for ACTION_SCREEN_OFF and USER_PRESENT events to trigger WebKit timer keep-alive loops during screen lock.

steps.title: Implement MediaSession API & Audio Focus Management
steps.description: Handle system audio focus request and media session metadata state updates across lock screen controls.

steps.title: Configure App Minimization and Back Navigation Behavior
steps.description: Ensure back press moves task to background instead of stopping audio playback.

steps.title: Verify Watch History SQLite Integration
steps.description: Maintain watch history logging and navigation within HistoryActivity.

steps.title: Building YouTube Background Player
steps.description: Compile final APK with continuous screen lock background audio rendering.
